scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! I've submitted a housing loan application and I'm inquiring about the status and details of my application. Can you please tell me what the current status of my application is? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: According to our records, your loan application (LOAN-01160) has been approved and originated. The action taken on your application was to originate the loan. Is there anything specific you'd like to know about your loan terms or details?

dialogue.user: That's great to hear that my application has been approved and originated! I'd like to know more about my loan terms. Can you please tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan are? I'd also appreciate it if you could let me know what my loan term is, although I do have that as 360 months from my records, I'd like to confirm.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.875%. The total loan costs are $4,328.75. And yes, your loan term is 360 months, which matches the information you had on file.

dialogue.user: So my interest rate is 6.875% and the total loan costs are $4,328.75. That's a bit higher than I was hoping for. Can you tell me if my loan has been sold or transferred to another institution? And are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Fannie Mae after origination. Regarding high-cost flags, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. Additionally, there are no negative amortization features on your loan.

dialogue.user: So my loan was sold to Fannie Mae, that's good to know. And I'm relieved to hear that my loan isn't considered a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA and doesn't have any negative amortization features. One more question: Can you tell me what type of loan product I was approved for? And also, do you have any information about my debt-to-income ratio and how it factored into my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan product type is Conventional: First Lien. As for your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, it was 48%. This is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. I can confirm that this information was considered as part of your application, but I don't have any further details on how it specifically factored into the decision. I've provided all the information I can based on your loan record. If you have any other questions or concerns, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: So my loan product is a Conventional First Lien, and my debt-to-income ratio was 48%. I appreciate you providing that information. I think I've got a good understanding of my loan details now. You've been helpful and clear in your explanations. I'm satisfied with the interaction. <Satisfied> I'm satisfied because the agent was competent, courteous, and provided clear information about my loan details. They also listened to my questions and addressed my concerns in a professional manner.
